web.activate.card_note: Card details are handled by Stripe. A redirect alone never activates a licence; the server verifies payment.
web.activate.hero_lead: After a verified payment, your signed licence appears here. Keep it for the panel it was issued to.
web.activate.manage_text: Save your checkout reference privately. It allows licence retrieval and subscription management. Do not share it. Your panel can refresh annual licences automatically when online.
web.activate.status_no_session: No checkout session has been provided. Payments and activation are not live yet.
web.commerce.refreshed: Licence refreshed for the paid period.
web.commerce.services_off_no_request: Payment services are not enabled. No activation request was made.
web.commerce.still_confirming: Payment is still being confirmed. Return using your original checkout link in a moment.
web.commerce.verified: Payment verified. Your signed licence is ready.
web.cta.text: Start with one panel. Make it feel like yours.
web.cta.title: Your home. Within reach.
web.features.card_alarm_text: A dedicated alarm editor, four original alarm tone choices, volume and optional gradual fade-in in APK 0.3.7.
web.features.card_compat_text: Aurelvi is a community project. Native sensors, audio and launcher commands vary by panel firmware. Sendspin remains experimental. A supported HA entity is required for each control; test a new release on your own device.
web.features.card_evening_text: Screensaver timing, night styling, brightness settings and optional proximity/motion behaviour. Sensor functions require sensor support from Android.
web.features.card_fans_text: Up to six speeds, custom presets, direction, brightness, colour temperature and timed shutoff. Controls depend on the capabilities of your HA entity.
web.features.card_layout_text: Visual grids, switches, dimmers, covers and readouts. Build room drafts controls from a selected HA area; review them before saving.
web.features.card_local_text: MQTT carries controls and confirmed states. The panel does not need a cloud account for local control. Internet is needed for downloads and online services.
web.features.card_look_text: 80 original palettes and procedural materials, five wallpapers, your own image upload, separate clock and screensaver styling.
web.features.card_notify_text: HA notifications with actions, a weather page, camera/MJPEG pages with bound PTZ actions, and a native media player integration.
web.features.card_setup_text: Connect over network ADB, install the latest official APK, set Aurelvi as Home and manage the device from Studio. Accept the first ADB prompt on the panel.
web.features.hero_lead: One familiar place for the things you use most. Aurelvi connects your NSPanel Pro to your Home Assistant entities.
web.features.intercom_text: APK 0.3.11 adds a SIP/WebRTC intercom preview. Choose one of up to 12 phone contacts, answer incoming calls explicitly, mute or hang up. A compatible SIP/WSS service and phone app are required. Locked-screen ringing needs provider push support; Aurelvi does not supply that service. Real-device calling still requires verification.
web.footer.tagline: Made for NSPanel Pro. Built around Home Assistant. Independent of Sonoff, ITEAD and Home Assistant.

web.gallery.materials_text: Eight locally bundled, photorealistic textures. Tap a material to inspect the grain, weave or veins. These are digital finishes for your panel.

web.index.feature_skins_text: Choose from 80 skins, add a wallpaper and set a calmer look for the evening.

web.pricing.full_text: All page types, styles and the visual editor. A watermark is shown.
web.pricing.invalid_panel_id: Enter a valid panel device ID.
web.pricing.lead: Use every page and all 80 styles for free with a watermark. An annual licence removes the watermark for one panel.
web.pricing.licence_combine: You may combine page-type licences on the same panel. Each panel needs its own licence. Existing signed licences keep their original scope and expiry.
web.pricing.licence_renewal: Annual subscriptions renew automatically at the displayed yearly price until cancelled. Cancel future renewal in the Stripe customer portal; access remains until the paid period ends. After expiry, only the watermark returns. Local controls keep working.
web.pricing.licence_title: One panel, one licence. Renewed yearly.
web.pricing.model_note: The new model is in preparation. The current preview stays free without a watermark. Purchases are disabled until payment, renewal and panel verification are tested.
web.pricing.page_note: Remove the watermark from all current and future page types during your paid period. Per panel, per year.
web.pricing.page_text: One page type, all its layouts and styles. Clock includes the screensaver. Per panel, per year.
web.pricing.stripe_note: Payment is handled by Stripe. Confirm the final price and billing terms at checkout.
web.pricing.tax_note: Final tax treatment will be confirmed before sales open. Check the total and renewal terms at checkout.
web.pricing.title: Every feature. Your choice.
web.setup.adb_enable_text: Enable ADB/network debugging using the supported procedure for your panel firmware. Find the panel IP in your router or Android network settings. The exact menu varies by firmware.
web.setup.adb_enable_title: Enable network ADB on the panel
web.setup.adb_open_text: In Studio, click Setup / Update. Enter the local panel IP and port 5555, then Connect / test ADB. On the panel, accept the RSA authorization prompt.
web.setup.add_text: Go to Settings → Devices & services → Add integration and search for Aurelvi. MQTT must already be configured. Open Aurelvi Studio in the sidebar.
web.setup.diagram_label: Illustration · use your own panel IP address
web.setup.discovered_text: Return to Aurelvi Studio. The panel should appear after it connects to the same MQTT broker. Add the panel to allow its control actions. If you add it manually, use the exact device ID shown by the app.
web.setup.hacs_text: In HACS, open the menu → Custom repositories. Paste the repository URL, choose Integration and add it. Find Aurelvi and download it.
web.setup.help_adb_text: Check that network debugging is enabled, HA can reach the panel IP/port, and the authorization prompt has been accepted. Firmware or network rules can block ADB.
web.setup.help_brightness_text: Update to integration 0.3.6 or later and restart HA. The fix safely omits missing light readings while preserving valid states. Keep the existing integration entry.
web.setup.help_editor_title: The old editor is still shown
web.setup.help_offline_text: Check MQTT WebSocket address, credentials, Aurelvi integration mode and exact device ID. HA and the panel must connect to the same broker.
web.setup.help_offline_title: The panel stays offline in Studio
web.setup.hero_lead: Install the integration. Connect the app. Build your first room. Follow the steps below — at your own pace.
web.setup.hero_title: A panel that feels like yours.
web.setup.install_note: HA must reach the panel directly. ADB works before MQTT pairing and does not require a separate HA add-on or a computer terminal.
web.setup.install_text: Click Install latest Aurelvi APK. HA downloads and verifies the official APK, installs it and opens the app. Set Aurelvi as Home if you want it to be the Android launcher.
web.setup.mqtt_text: Open the app settings. Set the MQTT WebSocket address and broker credentials, and select Aurelvi integration mode. Use the WebSocket port configured on your broker, not its regular MQTT TCP port.
web.setup.restart_text: Restart HA to load the installed integration. For an update, keep your existing Aurelvi integration entry.
web.setup.room_note: Room builder now lists every assigned entity. Select what to show, pair two lights or switches on one plate, and remove generated rooms with Remove room. Home Assistant areas are never deleted.
web.setup.room_text: Choose an HA area using Build room. Studio creates an editable draft from supported entities. Check the assigned entities, button actions and fan capabilities before saving.
web.setup.save_text: Click Save to panel. Try one control and confirm its real entity state in HA. Preview buttons on this website are illustrative; only the paired panel controls your home.
web.setup.save_title: Save, then test on the panel
web.setup.skin_text: In Appearance and wallpaper, choose a skin, one of the backgrounds or your own image. Adjust clock, screensaver and night settings in Display.
web.setup.step_ha_text: A working HA installation, MQTT integration and optionally HACS.
web.setup.step_mqtt_text: WebSocket access to your MQTT broker; network ADB for first installation.
web.setup.step_panel_text: An Android NSPanel Pro on the same local network as Home Assistant.
web.setup.terminal_text: Use your own panel IP and the path to the downloaded APK. Accept the authorization prompt on the panel.
web.setup.update_text: Update the HA integration through HACS or the release ZIP, then restart HA. Update the APK through Studio ADB or the app updater. The integration and APK have separate version numbers.
web.setup.update_title: Keep both parts up to date
web.setup.zip_text: Download aurelvi.zip, extract it and copy its aurelvi folder to /config/custom_components/aurelvi. Keep the folder name without a version number, then restart HA.
